web_fixture.title: API deprecation schedule - Otterwick Payments
web_fixture.snippet: Sunset timeline for pre-v2 endpoints, with migration notes for each removal.
web_fixture.content:
# API deprecation schedule - Otterwick Payments

Updated 2026-08-11. Pre-v2 endpoints keep working until the API version
in the right column removes them.

| endpoint | deprecated since | removed in |
| --- | --- | --- |
| /v1/payouts.raw | v7 | API version 13 |
| /v1/transfers | v8 | API version 14 |
| /v1/refs | v9 | API version 15 |

Move transfers to /v2/transfers.batch ahead of the autumn cutover.

web_fixture.title: Migrating transfers to v2
web_fixture.snippet: Since API version 8 transfers are deprecated; this guide maps v1 fields to v2.
web_fixture.content:
# Migrating transfers to v2

Transfers have been deprecated since API version 8. This guide maps
the v1 fields onto /v2/transfers.batch and lists the webhook events
that change names.

turns.prompt: Our billing service still calls /v1/transfers on the Otterwick Payments API. Give the number alone, as digits, with no label. In which API version will that endpoint be removed?
